title: Elpis AI
hook: A fully agentic personal AI built on MCP tool calling.
text: Elpis is my personal AI — a fully agentic assistant powered by MCP tool calling. Named after the Greek word for hope, it is a reflection of the work I have put in, the growth I have made, and the hope I have for what I can build next.
highlights: Agentic behaviour driven by MCP tool calling rather than a fixed script.
Built end-to-end as a personal system — design, tooling and integration.
Connects with Neoma through MCP, so study data is reachable conversationally.

caseStudy.problem: I wanted an assistant that could actually do things — reach tools, hold context and act on my behalf — not just answer questions in a chat box.
caseStudy.approach: Elpis is built around MCP tool calling. Each capability is exposed as a tool the model can choose and chain, which keeps behaviour agentic instead of hard-coded into prompts.
caseStudy.outcome: Elpis runs as my personal AI layer. It can be extended with new tools without rebuilding the assistant, and it connects to Neoma so study data becomes usable through conversation.
caseStudy.learned: The hard part of agentic systems is not the model — it is the boundary between the model and the tools. Clear tool contracts and small, purposeful tools matter more than elaborate prompts.
